subject: Scoring compatibility tests (#1436)
reason: The only product change is a narrow TOCTOU concurrency fix in TextIndexSchema::DeleteKeyData: it skips removing an emptied word from the stem tree if a concurrent add has re-added the word. It has no single-threaded observable effect (empty_words is only populated when the word has no remaining postings, so FindPostingsTarget is null and the new continue never fires without a concurrent writer), and its only visible effect requires a precise add/delete interleaving on the same stemmed word across writer threads.
